# Where `trp_cage.yaml` came from

The sequence `NLYIQWLKDGGPSSGRPPPS` is the Trp-cage miniprotein TC5b, PDB
[1L2Y](https://www.rcsb.org/structure/1L2Y), and it is the sequence BioEmu-2's
own documentation uses to introduce `System` and `Protein`
([docs/system.md](https://github.com/microsoft/bioemu2/blob/main/docs/system.md),
"Create a protein system"). Nothing here was generated by a model.

The YAML around it is this provider's request document, not upstream's file
format: the `system:` block is upstream's system YAML verbatim, and `mode`,
`num_samples` and `msa` are the provider's own keys. `System.to_yaml()` emits
exactly what belongs under `system:`.

The `msa` block is a **single-sequence alignment**, written here rather than
retrieved. It is the query sequence and nothing else, which is a legitimate
A3M and a poor alignment. It exists so the smoke step does not reach the public
ColabFold server; see the comment in the file.
